sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Ocean Box Brokerage

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived common-law corporate statutes; constitutional law; customary law and traditional land tenure)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986, as amended 2003)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act, 2000 (as amended); Counter-Terrorism Financing and Proliferation Financing (Banking, Money Remittance and Trust) Regulations, 2020; Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (B.C.A.), Title 27, Revised Statutes, sections governing registered agents and books/records; RMI National AML/CFT Strategy (2021–2025); and FIU directives issued under the AML/CFT Act.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in the country of origin of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille from the competent authority of the origination country; where the origination country is not a Hague Convention party, consular legalization at the nearest RMI diplomatic mission/consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) of each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate good standing certificate for any non-individual shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent commercial authority in the entity's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization through the issuing state's competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds description for each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Investment or commercial bank of the beneficial owner (or bank relationship manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization if required by the licensed RMI Registered Agent's internal KYC policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney or professional engagement letter appointing the RMI Licensed Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner or corporate signatory, notarized before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization, then Hague Apostille or consular legalization for jurisdictions requiring it; the RMI Registered Agent may accept a scan only upon prior compliance approval

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, the UK Financial Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the RMI FIU designated persons list; mandatory Politically Exposed Person (PEP) enhanced due diligence for foreign and domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates; continuous adverse-media and negative-news monitoring during the engagement; suspicious transaction and cash threshold reporting to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit as prescribed under the AML/CFT Act and 2020 Proliferation Financing Regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro) – all filings are submitted through an RMI Licensed Registered Agent; no direct public self-service portal is prescribed for non-resident incorporations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written entirely in Latin/Roman script using English alphabet characters; there is no requirement to use Marshallese script; names must be distinguishable on the RMI corporate registry; transliteration from a foreign script into English/Latin characters is mandatory for registration; a company may adopt a new registry name in English and reserve a trade name variously transliterated for internal commercial use.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested corporate name is rejected, the RMI Licensed Registered Agent shall deliver a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of Corporations within any statutory objection window of 15 business days from the date of the rejection notice. The appeal must contain: (a) a formal request for reconsideration; (b) the original rejection reference number; (c) documentary evidence of the distinguishing element of the proposed name or a verified letter of consent from the holder of a confusingly similar name; and (d) any applicable administrative fee imposed by the Registrar. The Registrar shall issue a written decision within 10 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may reserve an alternate name for a new 30-day reservation period; no further internal appeal rights exist until a company is incorporated, at which point a change-of-name action may be filed under the Business Corporations Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an offshore non-resident Business Corporation, the statutory registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands must be a physical street address maintained by a licensed Registered Agent; a 'virtual office' maintained solely for administrative, e-mail, or telephone communications may be used as the principal office outside RMI, but cannot replace the RMI statutory registered office. Virtual office acceptance is therefore deemed permissible for the principal office only, provided the statutory registered office remains a genuine physical location in Majuro or a designated RMI location.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated annual probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection of a non-resident, non-profit-exempt, archived-entity Business Corporation is approximately 5% for the RMI Registered Agent's records; probability increases to approximately 20-25% if the company later obtains an RMI Business License or engages in local business operations during any fiscal year.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act

Anti-Money Laundering / UBO KYC CDD compliance file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate services provider in the principal-office jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI BCA), Sections 12-13 (incorporators and Articles of Incorporation), Section 15 (registered office and registered agent), Section 17 (shares), Sections 42-47 (directors), Section 50 (officers), Section 71 (bylaws); ancillary Business License Act 1990 and Foreign Investment Business License Act 2001.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro; electronic lodgement via Registrar-approved registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation, endorsed by the Registrar of Corporations and issued as the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the RMI BCA; a nominal authorized capital (e.g., 50,000 common shares, no par value) is permissible; consideration may be cash, property, or services; no escrow or bank-deposit condition precedent; only the Registrar's filing fee and registered agent charges are required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 of the Republic of the Marshall Islands be ratified, and the subscription for the issued shares of common stock is approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the registered agent named in the Articles of Incorporation be adopted and ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the persons named as President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed as officers, with authority to execute documents, open bank accounts, and affix the corporate seal. RESOLVED FURTHER, that management is authorized to file all NVOCC and FMC licensing applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations (Name Clearance Desk); filings through RMI-licensed registered agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the RMI corporate index to confirm the proposed name is distinguishable; ensure the name includes a corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Corp.'; obtain written consent if the name is reserved; submit a name reservation application requesting a 30-day hold.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If declined, file a revised reservation with two alternative names; a conflict may be resolved by obtaining a written consent or undertaking from the prior nameholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators and drafting counsel; notary for acknowledgment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation under RMI BCA Sections 12-13; state the corporate name, registered agent and Majuro registered-office address, authorized share structure, and a general-purpose clause expressly covering ocean freight forwarding and NVOCC services; have the incorporators sign and acknowledge the Articles; obtain the registered agent's countersignature.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect is identified, execute a Certificate of Correction or amended Articles with the defective provision corrected prior to filing.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance; official government portal: https://www.rmi.gov.mh (no dedicated e-filing portal for non-resident tax-exempt corporations)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations (BCs) are not issued a Marshall Islands TIN or VAT ID. Upon incorporation, the BC obtains a Certificate of Incorporation and a registration number from the Office of the Registrar of Corporations. If the BC engages in any local conduct (e.g., employing residents), it must acquire an employer registration number from the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration. For customs purposes (import/export of physical goods), the entity must register as an importer/exporter with the Marshall Islands Customs Service and obtain a customs client code in the ASYCUDA World system. No VAT ID exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable in the U.S. check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch sense. Under the Business Corporations Act, a non-resident domestic corporation elects its exempt status by filing a declaration with the Registrar of Corporations confirming it will not carry on business within the Marshall Islands and designating a registered agent. Once that election is maintained through annual filings and government license fees, the corporation is exempt from all Marshall Islands income, withholding, capital gains, and gross-receipts taxation. No hybrid mismatch or pass-through election is available under RMI domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST or general sales and use tax; the RMI levies selective customs duties and excise taxes on certain imported goods (tobacco, alcohol, fuel, vehicles), plus municipal business license fees for on-island activities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Nil — there is no VAT/GST registration threshold. A non-resident NVOCC with no physical local activity is not required to obtain any indirect tax registration. Municipal business license requirements arise only if a business maintains a place of business or personnel in the Marshall Islands.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands does not mandate e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API connectivity, or digital stamping. Customs declarations are filed electronically through ASYCUDA World for import/export physical cargo clearance, but no tax clearance API or pre-shipment tax stamping regime applies to freight forwarding services or non-resident exporters.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — no VAT/GST exists, therefore there is no zero-rating mechanism. Exported goods and offshore services, including NVOCC ocean freight brokerage services rendered outside the Marshall Islands by a non-resident BC, fall entirely outside the RMI indirect tax net. No output tax is charged, and no refund claim is necessary.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (submitted via ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or House Bill of Lading (NVOCC issue)
Inward Remittance Certificate (only when required by trade finance banks; not a statutory RMI export tax document)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export zero-rating or clawback regime exists because no indirect tax is imposed on exports. However, fraudulent customs export declarations are subject to the RMI Customs and Excise Act penalties: civil fines, forfeiture and seizure of goods, monetary penalties up to ten times the evaded duty, and criminal sanctions including imprisonment. Additionally, a non-resident corporation that misrepresents its activities to the Registrar to obtain tax-exempt status may lose its exemption and be liable for all unpaid municipal license fees and penalties, without any VAT or export VAT clawback exposure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Banking Commissioner) – the RMI maintains no domestic central bank; the U.S. Federal Reserve System acts as the de facto monetary authority for the U.S. dollar.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility applies because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender of the Marshall Islands. There is no foreign exchange control statute, no requirement for exchange control approval, and no restriction on the repatriation of profits, capital returns, or intercompany settlements. Convertibility hurdles arise only from bank-level compliance: OFAC sanctions screening, anti-money laundering due diligence, and confirmation that the underlying transaction does not involve controlled goods or a sanctioned jurisdiction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule exists in the Marshall Islands. Export and service receipts, including freight forwarding fees, may be retained in U.S. dollars offshore or freely transferred. The mandatory conversion ratio is 0% and there is no statutory timeline for surrender or reinvestment.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not administer a stand-alone electronic money institution licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs are not eligible to take deposits or to offer deposit-taking treasury services to an RMI-incorporated business corporation. A U.S.-licensed money transmitter with correspondent access may be considered for incidental collections, but the primary operating and escrow accounts must sit with an RMI-licensed commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC interviews for each director, beneficial owner, and account signatory constitute the prevailing RMI banking standard. Remote opening is generally not available for a medium-risk NVOCC entity. Where physical attendance is impracticable, the bank may require a certified notarized affidavit, certified corporate resolutions, and, in the case of public documents, apostilled or legalized copies; approval remains entirely discretionary at the bank's compliance committee level.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership structured through layered Marshall Islands business corporations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, register of directors and shareholders, beneficial ownership attestation, ownership chain chart, shareholder passport copies and proof of residential address, audited financial statements or CPA compilation report, and a sworn declaration of source of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of meaningful local substance as an ocean freight forwarder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current RMI business license, physical office lease in Majuro, local agent or designated officer employment records, a valid NVOCC/FMC bond and licensing evidence for U.S.-related trades, freight forwarding agreements, warehouse or terminal arrangements, and audited evidence of operational capacity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity with offshore shippers, carriers, and consolidated freight counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Forecasted transaction matrix, master shipper/consignee list, executed logistics service contracts, proforma invoices, bills of lading, master air waybills or vessel space agreements, internal AML transaction-monitoring policies, and a written compliance procedure for identifying suspicious consignee patterns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity regarding source of funds for initial capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent bank statements of the funding shareholder, audited financial statements or tax returns of the beneficial owner, source-of-funds affidavit, sale-and-purchase documentation where capital derives from business disposal, bank reference letter from the remitting institution, and OFAC/SDN clearance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial equity capital should be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from a recognized banking institution to the RMI-licensed account. The payment narrative must identify the entity as MH_BC, reference the corporate registration number, and state the purpose as 'capital contribution / paid-in surplus.' Standard USD purpose code GENTR (general transfer) is acceptable where no RMI statutory code is prescribed. The supporting file must contain the board resolution approving the capital call, a source-of-funds statement, and a sanctions compliance verification. No exchange-control approval is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound freight settlements, carrier payments, port charges, and commission payments should clear through the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent network using SWIFT MT103 for direct transfers and MT202 for cover payments. Large disbursements can be routed over Fedwire or CHIPS. For less urgent U.S.-domestic disbursements, ACH direct is acceptable. Trade settlement may alternatively be structured as an irrevocable documentary credit via SWIFT MT700, with commercial invoices, bills of lading, packing lists, and original non-negotiable proofs attached for negotiation. All beneficiary names, account numbers, and address fields must be validated before release to avoid U.S. correspondent bank return fees and OFAC delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/JPY non-deliverable forward (NDF) for yen-denominated ocean freight billings
USD/EUR deliverable forward with an RMI-licensed bank or U.S. correspondent for European port surcharges
USD/AUD or USD/NZD cross-currency swap for trans-Pacific and Oceania freight receipts
European-style foreign exchange options for bunker adjustment factors and container repositioning surcharges

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (BCA Sec. 28) — corporate annual return identifying registered office, registered agent, directors, and officers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Business and Licensing Office, Ministry of Commerce, Majuro
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before October 31 of each calendar year (calendar-year regime; no anniversary grace)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the annual franchise tax; continued delinquency past December 31 exposes the corporation to administrative dissolution by the Registrar

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (BCA Sec. 21) — USD 250 for authorised capital of 10,000 shares or fewer; 500 for 10,001–1,000,000 shares
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Ministry of Finance, Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due and payable on or before October 31 of each calendar year (prepayment covering November 1 to October 31)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory surcharge of 10% of unpaid tax plus interest at 1% per month; failure to cure by December 31 permits administrative strike-off and loss of separate legal status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Register Audit — reconciliation of Register of Members, Register of Directors and Officers, and UBO ledger against BCA recording requirements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent's compliance function (government-inspection ready; no filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed annually before submission of the October 31 annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unresolved ledger mismatches block the agent's attestation of good standing and may be reported to the Registrar, triggering a compulsory inspection or corrective resolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Re-Confirmation (CRS/FATCA self-certification refresh)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (confidential UBO custody under MIARA Rules; accessible by M.I. Tax Authority for CRS exchange)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before December 31 per agent compliance calendar; any share transfer changing UBO must be reported to the agent within 15 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government filing fee; non-cooperation allows agent resignation, triggering a 3-month registered-agent vacancy notice and eventual administrative dissolution under BCA Sec. 30

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Retention (annual renewal of agent services)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (regulated by the Marshall Islands Association of Registered Agents)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before October 31, invoiced together with the franchise tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment causes agent resignation; failure to appoint a successor agent within 3 months leads to administrative dissolution by the Registrar

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing (optional; evidence for NVOCC counterparties, FMC bond sureties, and bank account reviews)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued on request for a certified copy; typically produced within 2–3 business days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not a periodic filing; certificate will be refused while any franchise tax or penalty remains unpaid

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a private non-resident Business Corporation under MIRC Title 27 (Business Corporations Act). Compulsory independent audit applies only to: (i) corporations listed on a recognised stock exchange; (ii) licensed banks, insurance companies, or trust companies; and (iii) resident companies not qualifying for the non-resident tax exemption. A Marshall Islands NVOCC freight-forwarding BC falls below all thresholds, and audit remains voluntary.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The BCA prescribes no fixed accounting framework; management may adopt IFRS, US GAAP, or another generally accepted framework, provided the books give a true and fair view of financial position. Financial statements are not filed with the Registrar and remain internal records.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and annually re-confirm a beneficial ownership self-certification for each shareholder of record and each ultimate beneficial owner holding 10% or more of shares, voting rights, or control. Any share transfer changing UBO must be notified to the registered agent within 15 days and reflected in the member ledger. No public UBO register is filed with the Government; UBO records are held confidentially and must be produced to the M.I. Tax Authority on request under the CRS exchange framework.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder ledger with transfer history)
Minute Book of shareholder and director resolutions
Beneficial Ownership Register (maintained by the registered agent)
Record of share certificates and cancellations (BCA Sec. 45)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 850 – 1,500 per annum (licensed Marshall Islands registered agent, including compliance administration and CRS handling)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0 — not statutorily required; voluntary audit of a non-complex NVOCC holding entity typically ranges USD 3,500 – 6,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident business corporations are wholly exempt from Marshall Islands income tax. A 3% gross revenue tax applies only to gross receipts sourced within the Republic; NVOCC ocean freight and logistics income derived wholly outside the RMI falls outside the taxable base, yielding a 0% effective RMI effective tax rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident BC with no RMI-source income. The only recurring filing is the Business Corporations Act annual report, submitted through the licensed registered agent; a Gross Revenue Tax return would only be triggered by taxable RMI-source receipts.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Anniversary-based; the annual report and renewal fee are due on or before the anniversary of incorporation as tracked by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered legal name of the business corporation as set out in the articles of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation; no RMI tax identification number is required for a non-resident exempt BC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and street address of the licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the full physical address of the RMI registered agent in Majuro; overseas correspondence addresses may be added but cannot replace the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value, and class structure reflected in the articles of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the authorized share scheme; the non-resident beneficial owner need not be disclosed in the annual report unless nominee arrangements are used.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers late fees charged by the Registrar, potential administrative dissolution, and reinstatement costs. While dissolved, the corporate veil is ineffective and shareholders may lose limited liability protection.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable because the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on non-resident BC distributions. The RMI maintains no comprehensive income tax treaty network and no tax-residency certificate is required for relief from a RMI dividend withholding tax, as no such tax arises.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on cross-border royalties and debt interest; no treaty relief is necessary because the RMI does not withhold on payments of either character.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory RMI threshold applies. For global tax-risk management, the recommended benchmark is USD 1,000,000 of aggregate intercompany charges before preparing a local-file-grade transfer pricing package for audits in revenue-hungry jurisdictions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI does not apply EU-style Economic Substance Regulations to non-resident business corporations. However, the NVOCC must retain genuine strategic management and operational substance outside the RMI to avoid adverse tax residency and CFC attacks in the shareholders' home jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Gross Revenue Tax Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misstating the country of income source, backdating NVOCC invoices, or routing RMI-origin freight revenue through foreign shell entities to avoid the 3% gross revenue tax on RMI-source receipts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Restitution of the avoided gross revenue tax, civil penalties up to 100% of the underpaid amount, criminal fines, and disqualification from operating a licensed NVOCC by the RMI Ministry of Finance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve false filings face personal liability for unpaid taxes, asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment under the RMI Criminal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the BC without regular board meetings, holding no NVOCC contracts, using shared bank accounts with related companies, or allowing a foreign parent to direct all ocean-freight transactions without separate corporate formalities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution by the Registrar; foreign courts may disregard the RMI corporation and reattribute freight income and liabilities to the parent or the ultimate beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and directors become personally liable for cargo claims, unpaid shipping charges, customs penalties, and freight-forwarding tariff liabilities once the corporate veil is pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Onboarding shippers and consignees without beneficial-owner verification, processing Swift or ACH payments for sanctioned cargo, or failing to maintain transaction monitoring commensurate with the bolero and box-brokerage cash flows of an NVOCC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI AML/CFT enforcement actions, financial penalties per violation under the applicable Money Laundering Control Act, and international de-risking leading to loss of all correspondent banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be criminally prosecuted for willful AML/sanctions violations, face personal financial penalties, travel restrictions, and imprisonment, and be disqualified from holding global shipping industry offices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding out as an NVOCC to United States cargo interests without obtaining an FMC license and surety bond or publishing a valid NVOCC tariff for the ocean common carriage activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: U.S. Federal Maritime Commission civil penalties of up to USD 30,000 per violation, per shipment or per day for continuing bond failures, plus CBP liquidated-damages claims against the surety.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under U.S. shipping statutes, principals and directors are jointly and severally liable for reparations to shippers and penalties, and the corporate veil is unavailable as a shield.
